Phir khud maut-o-hayat ka paida karna bayan kar raha hai, is aayat se un logon ne istidlal kiya hai jo kehte hain ke maut ek wujoodi amr hai kyunke woh bhi paida karda shuda hai. Duniya ko Allah Ta'ala ne hayat ka ghar bana diya phir maut ka aur aakhirat ko jaza ka phir baqa ka. Lekin yahi riwayat aur jagah Hazrat Qatada (R.A) ka apna qaul hona bayan ki gayi hai. Woh bawajood ghalib aur buland janab hone ke phir aasiyon aur sartab logon ke liye, jab woh rujoo karein aur tauba karein maaf karne aur bakhshne wala bhi hai. Jis ne saat aasman oopar tale paida kiye ek par ek, go baaz logon ne yeh bhi kaha hai ke ek par ek mila hua hai lekin dusra qaul yeh hai ke darmiyan mein jagah hai aur ek dusre ke oopar fasla hai, zyada sahih yahi qaul hai, aur Hadith-e-Meraj waghera se bhi yahi baat sabit hoti hai. Apni nazar aasman ki taraf daal aur gaur se dekh kar kahin koi aib, toot-phoot, jod-tod, shagaaf-o-surakh dikhayi deta hai? Phir bhi agar shak rahe toh do dafa dekh le koi nuqsan nazar na aaye ga, tu ne khoob nazrein jama kar tatol kar dekha ho phir bhi namumkin hai ke tujhe koi shikast-o-rekht nazar aaye, teri nigahain thak kar aur nakam ho kar neechi ho jayengi. Nuqsan ki nafi kar ke ab kamaal ka isbaat ho raha hai toh farmaya aasman-e-duniya ko hum ne in qudrati charaghon yani sitaron se baronaq bana rakha hai jin mein baaz chalne phirne wale hain aur baaz ek ja thehre rehne wale hain, phir un ka ek aur faida bayan ho raha hai ke un se shaitanon ko mara jata hai, un mein se sholay nikal kar un par girte hain, yeh nahin ke khud sitara un par toote, Wallahu A'lam.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain log jab tak duniya mein apne aap mein gaur karenge aur apni buraiyon ko aap dekh lenge halak na honge (Musnad Ahmad) aur hadith mein hai ke qayamat wale din is tarah hujjat qaim ki jayegi ke khud insaan samajh lega ke main dozakh mein jaane ke hi qabil hoon (Musnad Ahmad).

Allah Ta'ala un logon ko khushkhabri de raha hai jo apne Rab ke samne khade hone se darte rehte hain, go tanhai mein hon jahan kisi ki nigahein un par na pad sakein, taham khauf-e-Allah se kisi nafarmani ke kaam ko nahin karte na itaat-o-ibadat se jee churate hain. Un ke gunah bhi woh maaf farma deta hai aur zabardast sawab aur behtareen ajar inayat farmaye ga. Jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jin saat shakhson ko Janab-e-Bari apne Arsh ka saya us din de ga jis din us ke siwa koi saya na hoga, un mein ek woh hai jise koi maal-o-jamal wali aurat zina-kari ki taraf bulaye aur woh keh de ke main Allah se darta hoon. Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai ke Sahaba ne ek martaba kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hamare dilon ki jo kaifiyat aap ke samne hoti hai, aap ke baad woh nahin rehti. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh batao Rab ke sath tumhara kya khayal rehta hai? Jawab diya ke zahir-o-batin Allah hi ko hum Rab mante hain. Farmaya jao phir yeh nifaq nahin. Phir farmata hai ke tumhari chupi khuli baton ka mujhe ilm hai, dilon ke khatron se bhi aagah hoon. Yeh namumkin hai ke jo Khaliq ho woh Aalim na ho, makhlooq se Khaliq be-khabar ho, woh to bada bareek-been aur be-had khabar rakhne wala hai. Baad azan apni nemat ka izhar karta hai ke zameen ko us ne tumhare liye musakhar kar diya, woh sukoon ke sath thehri hui hai, hil-jul kar tumhein nuqsan nahin pahunchati, pahadon ki meikhein us mein gaad di hain, pani ke chashme us mein jari kar diye hain, raste us mein muhayya kar diye hain, qisam qisam ke nafa us mein rakh diye hain, phal aur anaj us mein se nikal raha hai, jis jagah tum jana chaho ja sakte ho, tarah tarah ki lambi chodi sood-mand tijaratein kar rahe ho, tumhari koshishein woh baar-awar karta hai aur tumhein un asbab se rozi de raha hai. Maloom hua ke asbab ke hasil karne ki koshish tawakkul ke khilaf nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai agar tum Allah ki zaat par poora poora bharosa karo to woh tumhein is tarah rizq de jis tarah parindon ko de raha hai ke apne ghonslon se khali pet nikalte hain aur aasooda-haal wapas jate hain. Pas un ka subh-o-sham aana jana aur rizq ko talash karna bhi tawakkul mein dakhil samjha gaya kyunke asbab ka paida karne wala, unhein aasan karne wala wahi Rab-e-Wahid hai, usi ki taraf Qayamat ke din lautna hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) waghera to (Manakib) se murad raste, kone aur idhar udhar ki jaghein lete hain, Qatada (R.H) waghera se marwi hai ke murad pahad hain. Hazrat Basheer bin Ka'ab (R.H) ne is ayat ki tilawat ki aur apni laundi se jis se unhein aulad hui thi farmaya ke agar (Manakib) ki sahih tafseer tum bata do to tum azad ho. Us ne kaha murad is se pahad hain. Aap ne Hazrat Abu Darda (R.A) se poocha, jawab mila ke yeh tafseer sahih hai.

Woh la-intaha afw-o-maghfirat ka maalik bhi aur giraft par qadir bhi hai. In aayaton mein bhi Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne lutf-o-rahmat ka bayan farma raha hai ke logon ke kufr-o-shirk ki bina par woh tarah tarah ke dunyawi azaab par bhi qadir hai lekin us ka ilm aur afw hai ke woh azaab nahin karta. Jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Wa lau yu'akhizullahu-nnasa bima kasabu ma taraka 'ala zahriha min dabbatin wa lakin yu'akh-khiruhum ila ajalim-musamma, fa-iza ja'a ajaluhum fa-innallaha kana bi-'ibadihi basira) (35. Fatir: 45), yani agar Allah Ta'ala logon ko un ki buraiyon par pakad leta to roo-e-zameen par kisi ko baqi na chhodta lekin woh ek muqarrara waqt tak unhein mohlat diye hue hai. Jab un ka woh waqt aa jayega to Allah un mujrim bandon se aap samajh lega. Yahan bhi farmaya ke zameen idhar udhar ho jati, hilne aur kanpne lag jati aur yeh saare ke saare is mein dhansa diye jaate, ya un par aisi aandhi bhej di jati jis mein patthar hote aur un ke dimagh tod diye jaate. Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Afamintum ay-yakhsifa bikum janibal-barri au yursila 'alaikum hasiban thumma la tajidu lakum wakila) (17. Al-Isra: 68) yani kya tum nadar ho gaye ho ke zameen ke kisi kinare mein tum dhans jao ya tum par woh patthar barsaye aur koi na ho jo tumhari wakalat kar sake, yahan bhi farman hai ke us waqt tumhein maloom ho jayega ke meri dhamkiyon ko aur daraway ko na manne ka anjam kya hota hai? Tum khud dekh lo ke pehle logon ne bhi na mana aur inkar kar ke meri baton ki takzeeb ki to un ka kis qadar bura aur ibratnak anjam hua. Kya tum meri qudraton ka rozmarra ka yeh mushahida nahin kar rahe ke parind tumhare saron par udte phirte hain kabhi dono paron se kabhi kisi ko rok kar, phir kya mere siwa koi aur unhein thame hue hai? Maine hawaon ko musakhkhar kar diya hai aur yeh mu'allaq udte phirte yehi yeh bhi mera lutf-o-karam aur rahmat-o-ni'mat hai. Makhlooqat ki hajatein zarooratein un ki islah aur behtari ka nigran aur kafeel main hi hoon, jaise aur jagah farmaya aayat (Alam yarau ilat-tairi musakhkharatin fi jawwis-sama') (16. An-Nahl: 79) kya unhon ne in parindon ko nahin dekha jo aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan musakhkhar hain jin ka thamne wala siwaye Zaat-e-Bari ke aur koi nahin yaqeenan is mein imandaron ke liye badi badi nishaniyan hain.

Razzaq sirf Rabb-e-Qadeer hai. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is aqeeday ki tardeed kar raha hai jo woh khayal rakhte thay ke jin buzurgon ki woh ibadat karte hain woh un ki imdad kar sakte hain aur unhein roziyan pohancha sakte hain. Farmata hai ke siwaye Allah ke na toh koi madad de sakta hai, na rozi pohancha sakta hai, na bacha sakta hai; kafiron ka yeh aqeeda mehez ek dhoka hai. Agar ab Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala tumhari roziyan rok le toh phir koi bhi unhein jaari nahin kar sakta. Dene lene par, paida karne aur fana karne par, rizq dene aur madad karne par sirf Allah Azza-wa-Jal Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ko hi qudrat hai. Yeh log khud ise dil se jaante hain, taham a'maal mein us ke sath dusron ko shareek karte hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh kuffar apni gumrahi, kaj-rawi, gunah aur sarkashi mein bahe chale jaate hain. Un ki tabiyaton mein zid, takabbur aur haq se inkaar balkay haq ki adawat baith chuki hai, yahan tak ke bhali baton ka sunna bhi unhein gawara nahin, amal karna toh kahan?

Phir momin-o-kafir ki misaal bayan farmata hai ke kafir ki misaal toh aisi hai jaise koi shakhs kamar kubri kar ke sar jhukaye nazrein neechi kiye chala ja raha hai, na raah dekhta hai na use maloom hai ke kahan ja raha hai balkay hairan, pareshan, raah bhoola aur hakka bakka hai. Aur momin ki misaal aisi hai jaise koi shakhs seedhi raah par seedha khara hua chal raha hai, rasta khud saaf aur bilkul seedha hai, yeh shakhs khud ise bakhoobi jaanta hai aur barabar sahih taur par achi chaal se chal raha hai. Yehi haal un ka Qayamat ke din hoga ke kafir toh oundhay munh Jahannam ki taraf jama kiye jayenge aur musalman izzat ke sath Jannat mein pohanchaye jayenge, jaise aur jagah hai aayat: (Ushurul-lazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (Surah As-Saffat: 22). Tarjuma: "Zalimon ko aur un jaison ko aur un ke un maboodon ko jo Allah ke siwa thay jama kar ke Jahannam ka rasta dikha do." Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) log munh ke bal chala kar kis tarah hashr kiye jayenge? Aap ne farmaya: "Jis ne pairon ke bal chalaya hai woh munh ke bal chalane par bhi qadir hai," Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai.

Allah woh hai jis ne tumhein pehli martaba jab ke tum kuch na thay paida kiya, tumhein kaan, aankh aur dil diye yani aql-o-idraak tum mein paida kiya, lekin tum bohat hi kam shukr guzari karte ho, yani apni in quwwaton ko Allah Ta'ala ki hukm-bardari mein aur us ki nafarmaniyon se bachne mein bohat hi kam kharch karte ho. Allah hi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein phaila diya, tumhari zabanain juda, tumhare rang-roop juda, tumhari shaklon suraton mein ikhtilaf, aur tum zameen ke chappa chappa par basa diye gaye. Phir is paragandagi aur bikharne ke baad woh waqt bhi aayega ke tum sab us ke samne kharay kar diye jaoge. Tarjuma: "Zalimon ko aur un jaison ko aur un ke un maboodon ko jo Allah ke siwa thay jama kar ke Jahannam ka rasta dikha do." Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya gaya ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) log munh ke bal chala kar kis tarah hashr kiye jayenge? Aap ne farmaya: "Jis ne pairon ke bal chalaya hai woh munh ke bal chalane par bhi qadir hai," Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai.

Allah woh hai jis ne tumhein pehli martaba jab ke tum kuch na thay paida kiya, tumhein kaan, aankh aur dil diye yani aql-o-idraak tum mein paida kiya, lekin tum bohat hi kam shukr guzari karte ho, yani apni in quwwaton ko Allah Ta'ala ki hukm-bardari mein aur us ki nafarmaniyon se bachne mein bohat hi kam kharch karte ho. Allah hi hai jis ne tumhein zameen mein phaila diya, tumhari zabanain juda, tumhare rang-roop juda, tumhari shaklon suraton mein ikhtilaf, aur tum zameen ke chappa chappa par basa diye gaye. Phir is paragandagi aur bikharne ke baad woh waqt bhi aayega ke tum sab us ke samne kharay kar diye jaoge. Us ne jis tarah tumhein idhar udhar phaila diya hai, isi tarah ek taraf sameit le ga aur jis tarah awwalan us ne tumhein paida kiya dobara tumhein lautaye ga.

Phir bayan hota hai ke kafir jo mar kar dobara jeene ke qail nahin woh is dusri zindagi ko muhal aur namumkin samajhte hain is ka bayan sun kar aitraz karte hain ke achha phir woh waqt kab aayega jis ki hamain khabar de rahe ho agar sache ho to bata do ke is paragandagi ke baad ijtima kab hoga? Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke in ko jawab do ke is ka ilm mujhe nahin ke Qayamat kab qaim hogi ise to sirf wohi Allam-ul-Ghuyub janta hai, han itna mujhe kaha gaya hai ke woh waqt aayega zaroor, meri haisiyat sirf yeh hai ke main tumhain khabardar kar doon aur is din ki holnakiyon se mutalla kar doon, mera farz tumhain pahuncha dena tha jise bihamdillah main ada kar chuka, phir irshad-e-Bari hota hai ke jab Qayamat qaim hone lagi aur kuffar ise apni aankhon dekh lenge aur maloom kar lenge ke ab woh qareeb aa gayi kyunke har aane wali cheez aa kar hi rehti hai, go der sawer se aaye, jab ise aaya hua payenge, jise ab tak jhutlate rahe to unhain bahut bura lagega kyunke apni ghaflat ka natija samne dekh lenge aur Qayamat ki holnakiyan [ A.Y ] badhawas kiye hue hongi, aasar sab samne honge us waqt un se bator-e-daant ke aur bator-e-tazleel karne ke kaha jayega yahi hai jis ki tum jaldi kar rahe the.

Dene lene par, paida karne aur fana karne par, rizq dene aur madad karne par sirf Allah Azza-wa-Jal Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ko hi qudrat hai. Yeh log khud ise dil se jaante hain, taham a'maal mein us ke sath dusron ko shareek karte hain. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh kuffar apni gumrahi, kaj-rawi, gunah aur sarkashi mein bahe chale jaate hain. Phir farmaya hum Rabb-ul-Alameen Rahman-o-Raheem par iman la chuke apne tamam umoor mein hamara bharosa aur tawakkul usi ki pak zaat par hai, jaise irshad farmaya aayat (فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۭ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ) (Surah Hud: 123) usi ki ibadat kar aur usi par bharosa kar, ab tum anqareeb jaan loge ke duniya aur aakhirat mein falah-o-behbood kise milti hai aur nuqsan-o-khusran mein kaun padta hai? Rabb ki rahmat kis par hai? Aur hidayat par kaun hai? Allah ka ghazab kis par hai aur buri raah par kaun hai? Phir farmata hai agar is pani ko jis ke peene par insani zindagi ka madar hai zameen choos le yani zameen se nikle hi nahin go tum khodte thak jao toh siwaye Allah Ta'ala ke koi hai jo behne wala ubalne aur jari hone wala pani tumhein de sake? Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Mulk ki tafsir khatam hui. Falhamdulillah Rabb-il-Alameen. (Hadith mein hai ke is aayat ke jawab mein Allah Rabb-ul-Alameen kehna chahiye. Mutarjim).
